name: Yuk Dae Jang
notes: not-found: no priced source better than a delivery marketplace could be located. No official restaurant website exists (Google Maps' own listing offers only an 'Add website' prompt). No first-party ordering platform (Toast/Clover/Square/Popmenu) found under this name for the San Diego / Clairemont Mesa location -- a same-name LA location has its own site (yukdaejangla.com) but that domain does not resolve and would not be this restaurant's pricing regardless. Google's 'Order online' button on the Maps listing offers only DoorDash, Grubhub, Seamless, Uber Eats and Postmates -- all delivery marketplaces, which this brief bars from being recorded as the price source. The Maps listing's Menu tab has no photo content (menu tab did not open/populate despite 929 total photos on the listing, suggesting none are tagged as menu pages). Address 7307 Clairemont Mesa Blvd confirmed. Recording as not-found rather than borrowing DoorDash's marked-up prices.
